payload.summary: Cowork */15 dispatcher is session-scoped with NO OS-level backstop — ~73h outage (2026-07-04T16:05Z -> 2026-07-07T17:30Z) silenced ALL guaranteed slots, not just chef.

root_cause.verdict: SESSION-SCOPED-DISPATCHER-SPOF (single point of failure, no OS-level firer). NOT a cron-expression bug, NOT a matcher bug, NOT the gateway-blind defect.
root_cause.mechanism: The cowork-team master dispatcher (`*/15 * * * *` CronCreate) lives ONLY inside a live Claude Code CLI session (`.claude/skills/cron-cowork-team/SKILL.md`: durable:true does NOT survive session-end). No CLI session was live from ~2026-07-04T16:05:03Z until ~2026-07-07T17:30Z (~73h). During that window NO slot fired regardless of type. chef-morning (05:15Z Mon-Fri) and chef-eod (08:45Z Mon-Fri) on 07-06 and 07-07 fell inside the dead window; the session only revived ~17:30Z today, after both slot times had passed. This is the documented gap `project_cowork_guaranteed_slot_needs_live_cli_session`.
root_cause.why_no_backstop: The two designed session-independent firing paths are both unavailable: (1) the claude.ai RemoteTrigger backstop is RETIRED by STANDING directive `feedback_no_remote_trigger_all_local` (all slots now show trigger_status:deleted / _superseded_by:cowork-dispatcher); (2) the launchd OS-level firer `com.vn-market.fb-daily-firer.plist` is DORMANT (verified NOT loaded via `launchctl list`) AND covers only fb-daily/fb-weekend, never chef/digest. Net: no OS-level firing path exists for chef/digest guaranteed slots.
root_cause.recurrence: Documented recurring failure mode (memory: project_cowork_guaranteed_slot_needs_live_cli_session; prior instance fb-daily 2026-06-30). Per `feedback_recurring_bug_escalation` (2+ occurrences -> block/escalate), this warrants a durable fix, not another symptom patch.

evidence_verified_from_files.dead_window_start: 2026-07-04T16:05:03Z (news-scout-offhours / market-watcher-offhours / alert-commander-critical last_fired) + fb-daily-firer.log last line 2026-07-04T17:44:35Z
evidence_verified_from_files.session_revival: ~2026-07-07T17:30Z — digest-daily last_fired 17:34:03Z, bctc-analyst-slot-2 18:03:06Z, chef-evening 19:47:50Z (FAILED-gateway-blind), tnb-audit 20:17:30Z all fired after revival, proving this was NOT a total-fleet outage but a no-live-session gap

missed_guaranteed_deliverables: chef-evening (daily 19:45Z): 07-04, 07-05, 07-06 MISSED (07-07 attempted but FAILED gateway-blind)
non-guaranteed collateral: news-scout/market-watcher off-hours + several bctc/refine slots frozen since 07-03/04

remediation_options.note: Architect must rule the approach — there is a real token-cost tradeoff (memory project_session_start_token_bloat_80k: fb-daily-firer.plist enabled ~= 160k/day if a full CLI session is spawned per tick). PLAN-ONLY: no auto-install here.
remediation_options.option_A: Load + extend the existing launchd firer model (scripts/cowork-fb-daily-firer.sh + com.vn-market.fb-daily-firer.plist) to cover chef-morning/chef-eod/chef-evening + digest-sunday guaranteed slots, with a LEAN headless invocation bounded to avoid the 160k/day session-start bloat. OPS installs (launchctl load), QA verifies with a session-down survival test (kill CLI session, confirm a guaranteed slot still fires at wall-clock).
remediation_options.option_B: Move guaranteed-slot generation to the always-on VPS (memory reference_vps_setup) — eliminates the local live-CLI dependency and the laptop token bloat entirely; larger scope.
remediation_options.decision_gate: architect brief weighing token cost vs reliability -> PO sign-off -> ops install -> QA session-down survival test.

explicitly_not_root_cause.gateway_blind: F-MCP-SUBAGENT-SYSTEMIC (session-wide gateway-blind, 4/4 confirmed this session) is a SEPARATE, already-ESCALATED issue (docs/signals/unified-agent-20260707T194500Z-gateway-blind.json) needing a /mcp reconnect or session restart. It explains today's chef-evening 19:45Z FAILURE and the router's 20:00Z spawn-withholding, but it CANNOT explain the 3-day outage that started 07-04, well before today's confirmations.

related_finding_resolved_together.F-GATHERER-OFFHOURS-STALL-0704: news-scout-offhours / market-watcher-offhours / alert-commander-critical all frozen at the identical 2026-07-04T16:05:03Z. This is NOT a separate defect — it is the same last tick of the prior live session (the dead-window start). Resolves together with Option A/B; today's router also additionally withheld re-spawning them citing gateway-blind.
